title: S3 Download Files

run.description: Download file(s) from S3 and save to the local file system.

file_key.description: S3 file key or list of keys to download.

save_as.description: Local filename or list of filenames to save the downloaded files as (replaces 'file').

endpoint_url.description: Override the S3 host for alternative S3 storage providers.

aws_access_key_id.description: Set the access key. Can also be set as an environment variable

aws_secret_access_key.description: Set the access secret. Can also be set as an environment variable

description: Download file(s) from S3 and save to the local file system.
guidance:
### Recipe
```yaml
run:
  on_start:
    - s3.download_files:
        bucket: s3-bucket
        key: example.csv
```

### Function
```python
from wrangles.connectors import s3
df = s3.download_files.run(
      bucket='bucket',
      key='key',
      file = 'example.csv',
)
```
